subtasks.label: approach
subtasks.definition: The empty gripper moves toward an object.

subtasks.label: grasp
subtasks.definition: The fingers close on an object until it moves with the gripper.

subtasks.label: transport
subtasks.definition: The gripper carries the object toward its target.

subtasks.label: place
subtasks.definition: The object is lowered or held above the target and released.

subtasks.label: retreat
subtasks.definition: The opened gripper moves away from the target.
